title: PreviewDiff: Multimodal Critic-Guided Search over Diffusion Latents
abstract: arXiv:2609.36199v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models can produce striking images and videos, but they still struggle with the compositional details that make a generation faithful to a prompt, such as object counts, attribute binding, spatial relations, and temporally grounded actions. A common way to improve prompt satisfaction is to spend more compute at test time through Best-of-N sampling, but final-sample selection is fixed. Best-of-N can only choose among completed outputs and cannot repair a promising trajectory before it fails. We introduce PreviewDiff, a training-free test-time search method that turns diffusion sampling from scalar search into a multimodal critic-guided search over intermediate latents. At selected denoising checkpoints, PreviewDiff decodes a partial preview, asks a multimodal judge to score and critique it, and uses the resulting natural-language feedback to branch over semantic prompt edits and locally re-noised latent continuations. translated_title: PreviewDiff：基于多模态评论家引导的扩散潜变量搜索
translated_abstract: 扩散模型可以生成令人惊叹的图像和视频，但它们在使生成结果忠实于提示词的组合细节方面仍然存在困难，例如物体数量、属性绑定、空间关系以及与时间对应的动作。提高提示词满足度的一种常见方法是通过Best-of-N采样在测试时投入更多计算量，但这种方式对最终样本的选择是固定的。Best-of-N只能在已完成的输出中进行挑选，无法在一条有希望的轨迹失败之前对其加以修复。我们提出了PreviewDiff，这是一种无需训练的测试时搜索方法，它将扩散采样从标量搜索转变为对中间潜变量的多模态评论家引导搜索。在选定的去噪检查点处，PreviewDiff解码出部分预览图像，让一个多模态评判模型对其评分并给出点评，然后利用由此产生的自然语言反馈，在语义提示词编辑和局部重新加噪的潜变量延续上进行分支搜索。
tldr: PreviewDiff提出了一种无需训练的测试时搜索方法，通过在去噪过程中解码部分预览并借助多模态评判模型给出的自然语言反馈，在潜变量空间进行分支搜索，从而提升扩散模型生成结果对提示词组合细节的忠实度。
en_tdlr: PreviewDiff is a training-free test-time search method that decodes partial previews at denoising checkpoints and uses multimodal critic feedback to branch over diffusion latents, improving compositional faithfulness of diffusion generations.
